subject: How do I pass multiple inputs to filter renderDataTable?

messages.author: 8a4e65e1eaf9ba10
messages.subject: How do I pass multiple inputs to filter renderDataTable?
parts:
How do I pass multiple inputs to renderDataTable? I can get it to work for one input, but after hours of searching cant find an example with two inputs for the one table.

For example Red is my logic, but im not sure of the syntax:

  output$mytable1 = renderDataTable({
    
    local_query_data[local_query_data$SD_PLATE_NUMBER == input$mytext, local_query_data[local_query_data$SD_DATE == input$dateRange,]
    
  }, options = list(orderClasses = TRUE))
